name: IR remote and receiver
author: Bench Workshop
description: The little 21-key infrared remote and an IR receiver module (VS1838B). Press the remote's keys in the run panel; every receiver on the bench picks up the code (NEC protocol). Includes IRremote.h, both its new (IrReceiver) and old (IRrecv) ways.

parts.name: IR receiver (VS1838B)
parts.description: Picks up infrared remotes. S (signal) to a pin, + to 3.3-5 V, - to GND. Its signal rests high and carries the remote's code (NEC: an address and a command). IrReceiver.begin(PIN); ... if (IrReceiver.decode()) { IrReceiver.decodedIRData.command ... IrReceiver.resume(); }

parts.name: IR remote (21 keys)
parts.description: The small "Car MP3" remote with its own coin cell. Press its keys in the run panel: every IR receiver on the bench gets the code. Address 0x00; commands: CH- 0x45, CH 0x46, CH+ 0x47, |<< 0x44, >>| 0x40, >|| 0x43, - 0x07, + 0x15, EQ 0x09, 0 0x16, 100+ 0x19, 200+ 0x0D, 1 0x0C, 2 0x18, 3 0x5E, 4 0x08, 5 0x1C, 6 0x5A, 7 0x42, 8 0x52, 9 0x4A.

examples.name: Remote control an LED
examples.description: Press 1 on the remote (its card in the run panel) to switch the LED on, 0 to switch it off; every key's code is printed in the serial monitor.
